name: 游侠笑传II
english_name: The Wandering Knight's Comic Saga II
english_description: The Wandering Knight's Comic Saga II. Supports dual-encoding clients — after connecting, players choose GB or BIG5 encoding, and the BIG5 prompt line deliberately appears garbled when viewed under GBK, an intentional design touch rather than an encoding bug. Registration runs through encoding choice, English ID, Chinese name, password with confirmation, talent selection (y to accept), email, and gender.
